findings.summary: Pagination overrides the list role with navigation, leaving list items without a list parent.
findings.fix:
Use
    ...
in blog and aggregator templates; put the Page x of y text outside the ul or in a li. Preserve native list semantics.
findings.evidence: <ul class="nav-pagination" role="navigation">; axe listitem finds .nav-pagination > li on7pages. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/listitem?application=axeAPI

findings.summary: Corporate member badge preview images have no text alternatives.
findings.fix: Give each informative preview alt text describing membership level and badge variant; use alt="" only if adjacent text conveys all preview information.
findings.evidence: Production axe image-alt:16images on badges page; .variant > img lacks alt. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/image-alt?application=axeAPI

findings.summary: The corporate membership level select has no programmatic accessible name.
findings.fix: Render field.label_tag for membership level and other label_fields so the label for attribute refers to its widget ID; associate errors/help text separately.
findings.evidence: Production axe select-name flags #id_membership_level; template emits {{ field.label }} as plain text. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/select-name?application=axeAPI

notes: ALT-001 and FORM-003 intentionally correlate existing source specialist findings; parent must deduplicate by rule and source location rather than score twice.
Native navigation landmark should wrap native list rather than replacing its role.
Final100pages: pagination7nodes across7pages, image alternatives16nodes on1page, select name1node on1page.
